role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 幻影刺客的猎物现身之际，就是她出手之时。她快速地接近目标，轻松地躲过攻击，残忍地收割敌人的性命。没有一丝预兆，她的任何攻击都有可能置人于死地。
hero_summary_en: The moment she finds her prey, Phantom Assassin strikes. Instantly closing in on a target, she effortlessly dodges attacks as she relentlessly cuts away at her foe. Without warning, any one of her attacks could prove suddenly and brutally fatal.

abilities.name: phantom_assassin_stifling_dagger
abilities.description_zh: 对敌方单位掷出一把匕首，减缓其移动速度，并造成物理伤害，数值为%base_damage%+幻影刺客攻击伤害的%attack_factor_tooltip%%%，同时继承物品和技能的攻击效果。
abilities.description_en: Throws a dagger slowing the enemy unit's movement speed, dealing %base_damage%+%attack_factor_tooltip%%% of Phantom Assassin's attack damage as physical damage and applying attack effects from items and abilities.
notes_zh: 如果攻击效果为几率触发，匕首的触发几率与原几率相同。
减益免疫下的敌人不会受到窒碍短匕的减速影响。
窒碍短匕在行进途中和击中目标时都会提供附近的视野。
notes_en: If an attack effect is chance-based, the chance of its application will be the same as its chance to occur.
Spell-immune enemies are not affected by Stifling Dagger's slow.
Stifling Dagger grants vision around its location while it travels and upon impact.

abilities.name: phantom_assassin_phantom_strike
abilities.description_zh: 传送到一个单位身旁，敌我皆可，如果目标是敌方单位将进行攻击并获得攻速加成。
abilities.description_en: Teleports to a unit, friendly or enemy, and grants bonus attack speed while attacking if it's an enemy unit.

abilities.name: phantom_assassin_blur
abilities.description_zh: 幻影刺客模糊自己的身形，躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道，提升她的移动速度，使她无法被看到，直到她靠近敌方英雄或防御塔。
abilities.description_en: Phantom Assassin blurs her body, disjointing incoming projectiles, increasing her movement speed, causing her to be impossible to see until she comes near enemy heroes or towers.
notes_zh: 通过普通攻击攻击肉山会驱散魅影无形。
notes_en: Attacking Roshan with a regular attack will dispel Blur.

shard_loc.en: Decreases Cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s. Any time Phantom Assassin gets a hero kill, her ability cooldowns advance %cooldown_refund_pct%%% of their max cooldown values.
shard_loc.zh: 冷却时间减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒。只要幻影刺客击杀英雄，她的技能冷却时间都会加快%cooldown_refund_pct%%%最高冷却时间。

abilities.name: phantom_assassin_fan_of_knives
abilities.description_zh: 幻影刺客对附近范围内敌人放出尖利的刀刃，击中时造成每名受害者最大生命值一定百分比的伤害并施加破坏效果。
abilities.description_en: Phantom Assassin releases sharp blades around her, dealing a percentage of each victim's max health on impact and applying Break.

abilities.name: phantom_assassin_immaterial
abilities.description_zh:
幻影刺客专注一心，闪避敌人攻击的技艺得到提升。

与其他闪避效果为非线性叠加。
abilities.description_en:
Phantom Assassin focuses inward, increasing her ability to evade enemy attacks.

Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.

abilities.name: phantom_assassin_coup_de_grace
abilities.description_zh: 幻影刺客的战斗技能得到精进，每次攻击时有几率获得致命专注。攻击时若带有致命专注，幻影刺客会消耗该效果，并且必定产生一次致命一击。窒碍短匕拥有额外几率获得致命专注。
abilities.description_en: Phantom Assassin refines her combat abilities, acquiring a chance of gaining Deadly Focus with each attack. When attacking with Deadly Focus, Phantom Assassin will consume the buff and guarantee a critical hit. Stifling Dagger has a bonus chance to cause Deadly Focus.
facet_text_en: Coup de Grace procs every %attacks_to_proc% attacks on the same hero or %attacks_to_proc_creeps% attacks on non hero units. Stifling Dagger counts as %two_tooltip% attacks.
facet_text_zh: 每攻击同个英雄%attacks_to_proc%次触发恩赐解脱，或者攻击同个非英雄单位%attacks_to_proc_creeps%次触发。窒碍短匕计为%two_tooltip%次攻击。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_phantom_assassin_2
facets_loc: -{s:bonus_attacks_to_proc} Attacks to Trigger Coup de Grace

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_phantom_assassin
talents_raw.desc_loc: Launches two extra Stifling Daggers towards random visible enemies within the cast range.
